name: Cambio
howTo:
Get the lowest total in your 4 cards. You only get to look at them now and then.

# Setup
- Each player gets a 2×2 grid face down; one card starts the discard pile.
- At the start, peek at your two nearest cards (tap a card, then Peek), then stop peeking.

# Your turn
- Draw from the deck or take the top discard.
- Swap it with one of your grid cards (that card goes to the discard), or discard it.
- Power cards, when discarded from the deck: 7 or 8 peek at one of your cards; 9 or 10 peek at someone else's; J or Q swap any two cards without looking; black K look at any card, then you may swap it.

# Matching
- When a card hits the discard, anyone may slap a card of the same rank from their own grid onto it. Wrong guess? Take a penalty card: drop a deck card on your mat.

# Ending
- On your turn you can press Cambio! instead of playing. Everyone else gets one more turn, then the dealer presses End Round.
- Scores: A = 1, 2 to 10 face value, J 11, Q 12, K 13, red K = -1, Joker 0. Lowest total after 5 rounds wins.
